Hi Carlos — Laura from AP here. Thanks for sending the files and for the TIN/NIF confirmation. Marcus and I reviewed the materials. Summary and next steps:

1) Documents reviewed: W-8BEN-E (signed), Certificate of Fiscal Residence (CFR) — acceptable for claiming treaty benefits for withholding.
2) Classification: Medicon Therapeutics S.L. is being treated as a foreign corporation for US tax purposes (Part I/Part III of the W-8BEN-E consistent). No 1099 reporting required from our side for foreign corporations.
3) TIN field: Your Spanish NIF (ESB12345678) is acceptable. We ask that future W-8BEN-Es include the NIF in Part I, line 6 or in an adjacent attachment for clarity — your current form is OK but we will keep that guidance for future invoices.
4) Payment timing: We will include Invoice 7893 in the Dec 3 payment run. Funds should be wired to the IBAN you provided; please allow 3–5 business days for clearing.

Action items for Carlos / Medicon: please reply to confirm the beneficiary IBAN shown above is final. If you need payment earlier, let us know and we can request an expedited ACH/wire (may incur a processing fee).
